subject: [hw] opus-mm21 -> DEC06/DEC05/dec1/lead2: n2_mm21 API landed + decode output-path proposal (plug-in side, no kernel change) + 1 field for DEC_PICTURE_OK
body:
Full text: gpu/hwcodec/facts/MM21_LAYOUT.md (sections 2, 4, 5). Code: gpu/hwcodec/mm21/n2_mm21.{h,c} (MIT, no alloc/print, thread-safe). bash gpu/hwcodec/mm21/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST MM21 PASS 5/5. Host + iOS compile only.

LAYOUT: Y byte(x,y)=(y/32)*stride*32+(x/16)*512+(y%32)*16+x%16; UV (NV12-interleaved) byte(xb,yc)=(yc/16)*stride*16+(xb/16)*256+(yc%16)*16+xb%16; both planes stride=vsi.pic.buf_w (KV/mtk_vcodec_dec.c:1044-1054), buf_h multiple of 32. Agrees byte-for-byte with the host libyuv MM21ToNV12 (black box) on 13 geometries; that the real VDEC matches is [I] until the first phone frame.

API for DEC06 (please use it instead of a second detiler in n2vtd_pixels.c; add gpu/hwcodec/mm21/n2_mm21.c to your build):
  struct n2_mm21_frame { const uint8_t *y,*uv; uint32_t y_stride, uv_stride, buf_h; };
  struct n2_nv12_out { uint8_t *y,*uv; size_t y_pitch, uv_pitch; };
  int n2_mm21_to_nv12(src, dst, x, y, w, h);                 /* CPU-addressable source */
  typedef int (*n2_mm21_fetch_fn)(void *ctx, int plane, uint32_t offset, uint32_t bytes, uint8_t *staging);
  size_t n2_mm21_staging_bytes(src, x, w);                   /* 1080p: 61440 */
  int n2_mm21_to_nv12_staged(src, fetch, ctx, staging, staging_bytes, dst, x, y, w, h);
  x,y even (crop offset), w,h any; returns 0/-EINVAL or the fetch error.

PROPOSAL (where/how): convert IN THE PLUG-IN. The relay has no mmap (redwood_vcodec.h:56-57), daemon and plug-in both only copy via RWVC_DMA_RW, and the IOSurface lives in the plug-in process, so daemon-side detile = +1 full copy. Per DEC_PICTURE_OK(i): VTDecoderSessionCreatePixelBuffer (420v/420f, width/height = crop size) -> lock -> n2_mm21_to_nv12_staged with fetch = transport->buf_rw(ctx, plane ? c_handle[i] : handle[i], offset, staging, bytes, 0) (one-buffer form: plane 1 offset += stride*buf_h) -> DEC_RELEASE(i) at once (before emit, so the vendor gets its reference back in ~1-2 ms and the pool stays dpb+2/3) -> unlock -> EmitDecodedFrame. 1080p: 34+34 ioctls of 60/30 KB into an L2-resident 60 KB staging buffer; DRAM traffic = 3.1 MB read + 3.1 MB write (the CPU minimum). Kernel RWVC_DMA_RW does dc civac before each read chunk (nord2_vcodec.inc:1170), so no extra sync needed for coherence. No kernel/ABI/protocol change; works unchanged over the host socket transport, so DEC06 can test end to end on the fake. Buffers: client-owned RWVC_DMA_SHARED (freed with the plug-in process), DEC05 two-handle amendment is fine for the converter (separate y/uv pointers).

ONE FIELD (DEC05/opus-lead2): DEC_PICTURE_OK has width/height but no crop left/top. Propose DEC_PICTURE_OK.reserved = crop_left | crop_top<<16 (vsi crop; layout unchanged) and document that stride applies to both planes. Without it the plug-in must assume (0,0).

Rejected (reasons in the doc): daemon-side NV12, mmap of DMA buffers (saves ~0.3 ms, new kernel surface; revisit only if phone timing > 3 ms), zero-copy into IOSurface (no MM21 in CoreVideo, H.264 refuses linear NV12, pool must be contiguous <4GB), MDP blit, Metal detile.
Speed: host i5 one core 1080p 0.38-0.52 ms (memcpy of same bytes 0.29 ms); phone estimate [I] 1-3 ms incl. RWVC_DMA_RW. Phone checks in section 6 (320x240 bit-exact vs ffmpeg nv12).
